questions.prompt: Which design rule is most appropriate when applying Secure File Upload Design?
options: Uploads, API calls, and webhooks cross trust boundaries. Limit file sizes, verify content and signatures, use timeouts, retry only safe operations, and make duplicate webhook delivery idempotent.
Trust request fields and skip authorization to keep handlers small.
Suppress all errors without recording safe diagnostic information.
Assume that adding CORS makes private routes authenticated.
questions.answer_key: Uploads, API calls, and webhooks cross trust boundaries. Limit file sizes, verify content and signatures, use timeouts, retry only safe operations, and make duplicate webhook delivery idempotent.
